subsystem.name: SessionStandingsRuntime
subsystem.responsibility: Guarded emission of session-event, commentary, season-result, and scoring-classification messages into the shared driver-data table, together with read-only standings queries and championship scoring over the race standings sort list rooted at dword_7D2DB0. All emitters gate on the race-active flag dword_7D0308 and the track-condition float flt_7CF3C8, build a local driver-data record via StructInitWithSentinelValues / DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, and commit it via InsertDriverTableEntry to the table anchored at flt_5EA618.

summary: DERIVED grouping of 18 validated IR functions that share two runtime objects. (1) The session-event emitters guard on dword_7D0308 (race active) and flt_7CF3C8 (track condition), build a driver-data record (message id, driver indices, position, timing parameters, sentinel -1 / -2.0 defaults) and commit it to the driver-data table at flt_5EA618. This family covers fixed event 337, standings/championship status, position-based status, the full race-commentary dispatcher, season-result messages 478-503, and scoring classification 427/483-487. (2) The standings/scoring helpers query the race standings sort list at dword_7D2DB0: best-lap/offset-408 key scans, composite and championship score computations, name-keyed point accumulation, constructor-team selection, and a family of null-guarded predicates over entry fields. Owner identity is almost entirely UNKNOWN in the packet; only RaceCommentarySystem is a named owner, and only offset 0x198 carries a dedicated field evidence reference. Contradiction kept explicit: equal offsets +408/+412 appear on standings entries under different bases, and flt_59E440 / flt_59E670 are listed as referenced globals but never appear in raw source.

function_roles.role: Emits fixed session-event message 337 into the driver-data table when the race-active guard (dword_7D0308 non-zero, flt_7CF3C8 non-zero) passes; record populated via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and committed via InsertDriverTableEntry.

Dispatches a standings/championship-status event: computes a driver index only in championship mode 4 (sub_4C2990 result plus one over dword_7D2DB0, else -1), derives a message id via sub_420000, populates and commits the record.

Dispatches a position-based race-status event: computes standings position plus two via sub_4C2990, selects live (-1.0/0.0) vs sentinel (-2.0/-2.0) timing parameters from boolean a1, derives a message id via 0x004203D0, populates and commits the record.

Race commentary dispatcher: matches the active track-configuration name (dword_8AC490 + 396*dword_8AC48C, name at +260) against 17 track literals to pick a track-intro commentary id, scans vehicle-slot pointers dword_7C54F0 for retirements and the best-lap car, emits player-relative position-change commentary (459/460/461/397) and a wrap-up commentary (454/455/456/476), each record committed to the driver-data table.

Resolves and emits season/championship result display messages (478-503) and leader/best-lap messages (479/480/481/397): selects season vs race-session mode from node flags and the offset-45380 season selector, picks the message by which track-database version files exist (sub_588410 against aF11999Gdb..aF12002Gdb), resolves entrant display ids through NamedEntryLookupInFormatList against dword_5EA5E8 (byte_5EA438 null fallback), and finalizes with InsertDriverTableEntry plus PositionChangeDetector.

Computes and dispatches scoring-classification display messages (427, 483-487): resolves driver and constructor classification entries via sub_41F340 / sub_41F5D0, selects the message by session flags, the offset-45380 season selector, driver/constructor name equality, and championship-point deltas (485/486/487) or constructor clinch (484), then inserts the record and parses constructor standings; allocated entries freed via 0x00587BCF.
Null-guarded accessor that dereferences the standings list at dword_7D2DB0 and reads the dword at +408 of a standings-derived object (via FixedOffsetReturn); returns 0 at either null guard.

Scans standings entries and returns the entry with the highest value at offset 408, optionally name-filtered via sub_588410; strict mode (a2==0) returns 0 if the best value is duplicated, including by the first entry.

Computes a composite score by summing a named entrant's scoring values across all but the first category from the standings node; returns -1 when the node is absent, fewer than two categories exist, or no matching entry is found.

Determines whether the given standings entry leads or ties the cumulative championship total at any scoring-category prefix, accumulating per-slot running totals via IndexedFieldGetter; returns 1 on any lead/tic, else 0. Used by SeasonDisplayIDResolver as the championship-score gate.

Counts dword entries in a caller-provided array at a1+24 that equal the value a2, bounded by the standings node count read via FlagsGetter; returns 0 when the node is absent or the count is not greater than 0.
Performance-gap predicate: returns whether this standings entry's offset-0x198 key exceeds the maximum key of every other active entry by at least 10.
Predicate returning true only when this is non-null, the standings node count v3 >= 3, and the three consecutive indexed dword fields this[v3+52..54] all equal the literal 10.
Predicate returning true only when this is non-null, the standings node count v3 > 0, and the indexed field this[v3+5] is at most 4.

Validates a standings entry: returns the AND of the base validity flag ShortComputation_f1e0(this) and a category-dependent condition (entry valid when category count is exactly 2, or greater than 2 and this[v3+51] != sentinel 10).
Predicate returning true only when this is non-null, the standings node count v3 >= 2, and the two consecutive indexed dword fields this[v3+4] and this[v3+5] both equal the literal 1.

Accumulates championship points for a named entrant across a category count by summing IndexedFieldGetter(entry, i) over every active standings entry whose resolved scene name matches the input name; null name returns -1, category count -1 delegates to the total-points lookup sub_4C13C0.

Iterates the 14 constructor team names over the standings node and returns the team with the highest championship-points total (ChampionshipPointsAccumulator at categories-1), optionally excluding a named team; allocates an 8-byte [name, score] pair and optionally re-scans to confirm the winner by name.

classes.name: DriverDataRecord
classes.responsibility: Local driver-table-entry record buffer: initialized by StructInitWithSentinelValues and populated by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with a message id, driver indices, position, and timing parameters (defaults -1 / -2.0), then committed to the DriverDataTable. Field offsets are not observable in this packet; the record is treated as an opaque stack buffer.

classes.name: DriverDataTable
classes.responsibility: Shared session event / driver-data table anchored at flt_5EA618; records are appended via InsertDriverTableEntry. No member offsets are observable in this packet.

classes.name: SessionEventDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Guarded session-event message emitters that build a DriverDataRecord and commit it to the DriverDataTable: fixed event 337, standings/championship-status, and position-based race-status. All gate on dword_7D0308 and flt_7CF3C8. Packet owner is UnknownObject; this class is a semantic grouping (GUESS).

classes.name: RaceCommentarySystem
classes.responsibility: Race commentary dispatch: emits track-intro, player-relative position-change, and wrap-up commentary records into the DriverDataTable, driven by the active track-configuration name and vehicle-slot states. The only function in the packet with a named owner.

classes.name: StandingsDisplayDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Standings-derived display dispatch: resolves and emits season-result messages (478-503), scoring-classification messages (427, 483-487), and leader/best-lap messages by resolving entrant display ids from the format list dword_5EA5E8 and committing records to the DriverDataTable. Packet owner is UnknownObject; semantic grouping (GUESS).

classes.name: RaceStandingsNode
classes.responsibility: Shared race standings / sort list rooted at dword_7D2DB0: exposes a dereference-able node (LinkedListDereference), a base entry (FixedOffsetReturn) and indexed entries (ShortComputation_13a0), plus per-entry sort keys at +0x198, an active flag at +0x19C, and a season-mode selector at +0xB144 on the node. Owns the query/accessor/predicate helpers whose packet owner is UnknownObject; the accessor-callee identities (0x004C2850/0x004C11D0/0x004C1370/0x004C1390/0x004C13A0) are DERIVED from usage.

classes.name: ChampionshipScoring
classes.responsibility: Championship scoring computations over the standings entries: per-entrant composite totals (0x0041ED30), championship lead tests (0x0041EDA0), name-keyed point accumulation (0x0041F220), and top-constructor-team selection (0x0041F5D0). Packet owner is UnknownObject; semantic grouping (GUESS).

interfaces.name: SessionEventEmitter
interfaces.purpose: Contract implemented by every guarded emitter in this scope: when the race-active guard (dword_7D0308, flt_7CF3C8) passes, build a DriverDataRecord and commit it to the DriverDataTable at flt_5EA618.

interfaces.name: StandingsQueries
interfaces.purpose: Read-only queries and predicates over the race standings node and its entries, consumed by scoring, display, and AI selection logic.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverDataTableCommit
compatibility_contracts.description: Session event messages are committed as records into the table anchored at 0x005EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry (0x00418560). A replacement executable must preserve the record-building convention: StructInitWithSentinelValues (0x004144D0) then DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion (0x004144F0) with message id, driver/position indices (default -1) and timing parameters (default -2.0).

compatibility_contracts.name: RaceActiveEventGuard
compatibility_contracts.description: Every emitter in this scope runs only when dword_7D0308 (race active) is non-zero AND flt_7CF3C8 (track condition) is non-zero; otherwise the dispatch is skipped. A replacement must honor the same gating or reproduce equivalent event-suppression behavior.

compatibility_contracts.name: StandingsListLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The standings object at dword_7D2DB0 dereferences to a node exposing a base entry and indexed entries. Entry offset 0x198 is an int sort key used for best/performance comparisons; entry offset 0x19C non-zero marks an active entry; node offset 0xB144 equal to 3 selects season mode (vs race-session mode selected by node session flags equal to 1). Offsets GUESS/DERIVED from usage, not struct-confirmed.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionEventMessageIdSpace
compatibility_contracts.description: Distinct message-id families are used: 337 (fixed event), 397 (generic position change), 427 (classification fallback), 447-476 (race commentary, including track-intro 447-473 by track name and wrap-up 454/455/456/476), 478-503 (season results), 479/480/481 (leader/best-lap), 483-487 (scoring classification). Their mapping to actual audio/text resources is DERIVED-only and not runtime-confirmed.

unresolved: flt_59E440 (0x0059E440) is listed as a referenced global across many functions but never appears in the raw source text; its role (claimed ZeroThreshold in existing analysis) is not grounded in this packet.
flt_59E670 (0x0059E670) is listed as a referenced global by RaceCommentary but is not referenced by the raw source; no operation uses it.

The -1 / -1 / -1 / -2.0 / -2.0 placeholder arguments passed to DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion are sentinel defaults; their meaning depends on that callee's own semantics, which are not in this packet.
Message ids 337, 397, 427, 447-476, 478-503 map to DERIVED dispatch positions only; the correspondence to audio/text resources is not established.
The comparison semantics of sub_588410 (0x00588410) and sub_566810 (0x00566810) - exact match versus substring - are not defined by this packet; both are treated as name comparisons.

Standings entry/node fields +408 (sort key), +412 (active flag), +45380 (season mode), and the index-relative fields this[v3+4..5], this[v3+51], this[v3+52..54] are inferred from usage, not confirmed against a struct definition. Equal offsets +408/+412 recur on different bases and are not proven to share ownership.

Vehicle-slot offsets +16472 (position), +16480 (index), +16484 (status, 2=retired), +16540 (best lap float) and +18588 (driver id), plus track-config offset +260 (name), are inferred from RaceCommentary usage only.
The semantics of championship mode value 4, the +1/+2 position adjustments on sub_4C2990 results, and the -1 default driver index are caller- and data-dependent and unverified.
sub_420000 (0x00420000) and 0x004203D0 message-id computations, and the CRTMathHelper timing comparison in SeasonDisplayIDResolver (units unknown), require their own function analysis.
Standings node session-flag value 1 and season-selector value 3 at offset 45380 are derived from surrounding logic; the enum meaning is unproven.
The 14 constructor team names (jump tables jpt_41F635 at 0x0041F82C and jpt_41F715 at 0x0041F864) map to teams in a fixed switch order that is not correlated with the category range FlagsGetter-1.

Most function owners are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN in the packet; only RaceCommentarySystem is a named owner. Class groupings (SessionEventDispatcher, StandingsDisplayDispatcher, ChampionshipScoring) are semantic GUESS groupings, not proven object boundaries.
In ScoringClassificationDisplay, v31 = ChampionshipPointsAccumulator() is called with no visible arguments (decompiler artifact); its contribution to the delta computation is unproven.

In AccumulateChampionshipPointsByName, discarded LinkedListDereference/FixedOffsetReturn/ShortComputation_13a0 returns suggest shared side-effect state consumed by SceneNameLookupBySeason (0x004C0A20); the mechanism is not visible in this function, and the first/base entry may be counted twice per category.

The caller relationships 0x0040DE60 (to the three SessionEventDispatcher emitters) and 0x0046BF10 (to RaceCommentary) are known but their frame paths and call frequency are not established; NestedDataSectionFieldAccessor's caller 0x00418EE0 is known only by prose, with no caller evidence ref in the packet.
CountMatchingSeasonEntries operates on an array at a1+24; the owning class of a1 and the 24-byte prefix skipped before the counted array are unknown.
The meaning of the value at entry offset 408 (a best-lap time, index, or counter) is not established beyond its comparison behavior.
byte_5EA438 acts as a fallback default name/path when an entry name is null; its concrete content is unknown.
